title: Excise harness counts v1
description: The deterministic counts of one build of excise: numbers that, for a given binary and fixture, do not depend on timing or load. Internal test tooling, not a supported product interface. A pull request's counts arrive as an artifact, which is untrusted input, so every reader holds a document to this schema, and to the limits in it, before it uses a field.

cases.description: One entry per fixture and profile, in the order they were counted. A fixture and profile appear at most once, which this schema cannot say and the readers check.

count.description: A non-negative whole number that every JSON consumer reads back exactly (at most 2^53 - 1).

sha.description: A full, lowercase hexadecimal git commit.

printable.description: One line of printable ASCII, at most 120 characters. Free text from an artifact is untrusted, so what a reader may meet in it is bounded by this pattern.

hash.description: The hash of the fixture manifest. Counts are comparable only between documents whose hash for the case is equal.

metrics.description: The counts, by metric name. A deliberately open vocabulary: a build that counts one more thing adds a name and keeps version 1, and a reader shows a name it does not know as a plain count.

os.description: The operating system as std::env::consts::OS spells it, for example linux. It names the directory of the history branch that holds the record.

os_version.description: The operating system and its version, for example Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS.

arch.description: The CPU architecture as std::env::consts::ARCH spells it, for example x86_64.

base_sha.description: The commit the pull request was based on when the counts were taken. A comment compares with the record of this commit, or of its nearest ancestor that has one.

head_sha.description: The tip of the pull request's branch. The counts are of the merge of this tip into the base, which context.git_sha names.

git_sha.description: The commit that was built and counted.

committed_at.description: When that commit was committed: a property of the commit, so that two counts of one commit write the same document.

toolchain.description: The first line of rustc --version for the toolchain that built the binary.

pull_request.description: The pull request the counts were taken for. Absent in a record of a commit on main.
